articles.title: UNRULY — A New Book About the Joy/Thrill of the Unexpected (and the Ig Nobel Prizes)
articles.summary: Upasana Sarraju's new book, 'Unruly: The Ig Nobel Prizes and The Science That Refuses to Behave,' explores unconventional and often humorous scientific discoveries. It delves into a universe of unexpected research, drawing inspiration from the Ig Nobel Prizes, which honor peculiar but significant scientific achievements. The book aims to make complex and quirky scientific phenomena accessible.

articles.title: Deterrence or declaration? The case for revisiting India’s Cold Start doctrine
articles.summary: Following 'Operation Sindoor,' the Army hierarchy has announced its strategic intent to significantly ramp up and modernize its existing 'Cold Start Doctrine.' This enhanced military strategy will be rechristened as 'Cold Strike,' signaling an evolution in the Army's operational approach. This move aims to ensure more agile and decisive response capabilities in future engagements.

articles.title: Army commander inaugurates ‘Banwat Ekta Sthal’ near LoC in Poonch
articles.summary: Army's Northern Commander, Lt Gen Pratik Sharma, inaugurated the 'Banwat Ekta Sthal' monument near the LoC in Poonch. This public monument symbolizes national pride and sovereignty, reinforcing unity in a sensitive border region. It highlights India's resolve and the critical importance of border areas for both citizens and security forces, strengthening national morale and defence.

articles.title: Another witness identifies Malik, Pahloo in 1990 IAF attack case
articles.summary: Another eyewitness identified JKLF chief Yasin Malik and Mohd Rafiq Pahloo as shooters in the January 25, 1990 incident in Jammu. This ongoing legal proceeding concerns historical acts of militancy in Jammu & Kashmir. The identification is crucial for prosecuting separatist leaders involved in past violence, highlighting India's persistent efforts to bring justice and combat terrorism.

articles.title: Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Dhami lays foundation stones for 34 projects worth Rs 234 crore for Kumbh Mela 2027
articles.summary: Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami has laid foundation stones for 34 projects, worth Rs 234 crore, in preparation for the Kumbh Mela 2027. This significant investment aims to bolster infrastructure and facilities for the large-scale religious congregation, ensuring smooth arrangements and pilgrim convenience in the state, highlighting government focus on major national events.

articles.title: WBSSC mandates slippers for Group C, D exams: Covered shoes not allowed at centres, details here
articles.summary: The West Bengal Staff Selection Commission (WBSSC) has issued a directive for its upcoming Group C and D examinations, mandating candidates to wear slippers. Covered shoes are strictly prohibited at all exam centres. This new rule aims to enhance exam integrity and streamline security checks, preventing any potential malpractices and ensuring a smoother process for aspirants taking these competitive tests across West Bengal.
